MusiX is a video game about buying creatures that make music together.

Adopt them using Notes, the ingame currency!

Earn these Notes by playing minigames!

Keep in mind that this is just a demo, so more content will come soon!

The wiki: https://musix.fandom.com/wiki/MusiX_Wiki

The Discord: https://discord.gg/99jcTwfPry

eventsFunctions.description: Fetch complete user data from Gamejolt.
eventsFunctions.name: FetchUser
eventsFunctions.sentence: Send request _PARAM1_ and fetch _PARAM2_ user data using identifier: _PARAM3_

parameters.longDescription:
**Result format** - 
Array named **``users``** of elements having the following structure:
* **``id``** (number): the identifier of the user
* **``type``** (string): the type of user. Can be ``User``, ``Developer``, ``Moderator``, or ``Administrator``
* **``username``** (string): the user's username
* **``avatar_url``** (string): the URL of the user's avatar
* **``signed_up``** (string): how long ago the user signed up
* **``signed_up_timestamp``** (number): the timestamp (in seconds) of when the user signed up
* **``last_logged_in``** (string): how long ago the user was last logged in
* **``last_logged_in_timestamp``** (number): the timestamp (in seconds) of when the user was last logged in
* **``status``** (string): ``Active`` if the user is still a member of the site. ``Banned`` if they've been banned
* **``developer_name``** (string): the user's display name
* **``developer_website``** (string): the user's website (or empty string if not specified) 
* **``developer_description``** (string): the user's profile markdown description
parameters.name: RequestName

parameters.longDescription:
You can use comma-separated list to find multiple users
Example 1: gdevelop,player123,snailmaster
Example 2: 321123,505050,778899

eventsFunctionsExtensions.name: PopUp
eventsFunctionsExtensions.shortDescription: Display pop-ups to alert, ask confirmation, and let user type a response in text box.
description: This extension adds actions to display three kinds of pop-ups.
- Pops-up a message that will pause the game until dismissed by the player.
- Pops-up a dialogue containing a message with the option to either confirm or cancel.
**Note that this pop-up type is unsupported on previews and PC exports.**
- Displays a message to the player with a text field to write an answer in. The player will also have the option to either confirm or discard their input.
### Usage to save a value from a popup box:
![Screenshot of the way to use the extension to save a value in a variable](https://i.imgur.com/2iR5ofz.png)

- background is resized to take the full dimensions of the parent
- the bar size is refreshed according to the value

description: * Do coyote time, also known as "ledge tolerance". It lets players jumping even after their character is no longer touching the ground for a given amount of time. It aims to give players a feeling of control and reduce frustration.
An example allows to check it out ([open the project online](https://editor.gdevelop.io/?project=example://platformer-moves)).

Coyote jump
The new value will be used next frame.
While in the coyote jump frame, the Object is treated as being on the floor. No air jump can happen.
When the object fall, it doesn't jump but air jumps must be allowed

The order of these events is important because the idle state is:
on the floor and jump key released but the 1st jump must not count.
Reset air jump counter.
Allow air jumps.

events.comment:
When zooming the vector in pixels from the center to the anchor must stay the same.
It gives this system:

/ pixel_delta(t-1) = (anchor - center(t-1)) * zoom(t-1)
| pixel_delta(t) = (anchor - center(t)) * zoom(t)
\ pixel_delta(t) = pixel_delta(t-1)

where the new center can be resolved to:

center(t) = anchor + (center(t-1) - anchor) * zoom(t-1) / zoom(t)

parameters:
GetArgumentAsNumber("AnchorX")
+ (
   CameraX(GetArgumentAsString("Layer"), GetArgumentAsNumber("Camera"))
   - GetArgumentAsNumber("AnchorX")
)
* CameraZoom(GetArgumentAsString("Layer"), GetArgumentAsNumber("Camera"))
/ GetArgumentAsNumber("Zoom")

GetArgumentAsNumber("AnchorY")
+ (
   CameraY(GetArgumentAsString("Layer"), GetArgumentAsNumber("Camera"))
   - GetArgumentAsNumber("AnchorY")
)
* CameraZoom(GetArgumentAsString("Layer"), GetArgumentAsNumber("Camera"))
/ GetArgumentAsNumber("Zoom")

inlineCode: Get the object layer, convert the position from this layer to the screen coordinates.
Get the point on each side on the object on screen, and compare with the screen area.
This way even if the camera has a rotation or custom scale the object is always compared to the screen area.
// Get the layer of the object.

// Get the points on each side of the object on screen.
const posLeftObjectOnScreen = Math.min(topLeft[0], topRight[0], bottomLeft[0], bottomRight[0]);

events.comment:
Create one background instance for of each state.
Only the instance for the current state is shown.
Place the label over the backgrounds.
Show the right background accordingly to the new state.

Children instances must be resized when the button size change:
- backgrounds for each state are resized to take the full dimensions of the button
- the label is put back at the center of the button

The scale is set back to 1 because it means that the parent instance has the same dimensions as the union of its children instances.
